confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregator sites and a local guide with mixed dates (Expatistan 2021 and 2023, Expat Exchange 2025, MyLifeElsewhere undated), so they are rough. Beer, cocktail and wine are weakly supported: the beer figure comes from a 2021 pub listing and supermarket prices, and the cocktail and wine figures use the local beer relationship plus upscale Malaysian resort menus, which overstate Ipoh's usual prices. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Ipoh context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX: the 0.6947 USD per AUD observation for 2026-10-16 came from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly, so verify it on rba.gov.au before relying on it. Conversions in the anchors assume roughly MYR 4.1 to 4.2 per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city was used. The basis is Ipoh-specific local price points (kopitiam and hawker meals, cafe cappuccino, pub and supermarket beer) from aggregator sites, adjusted to a regional Malaysian secondary-city level. Upscale Malaysian resort and hotel drink menus were used only as upper bounds for cocktail and wine.
